- **Package defaults:** `@tintinweb/pi-subagents`, `billion-context`, `pi-provider-kimi-code` and `@amaster.ai/pi-computer-use` are not in node_modules. I read the pinned releases with `npm pack` into the scratchpad and cite them in `PACKAGE_DEFAULTS`. Codemode's default `on` comes from the installed Pi package.
